# Community support

Sparkfeed Community Edition has best-effort support. The project does not promise a response time, installation service, uptime, backups, or a service-level agreement.

Use a public issue for a reproducible product defect. Include the Sparkfeed version, deployment method, database version, relevant logs with secrets removed, and reproduction steps.

Use a discussion for setup questions and product ideas when discussions are available. Search existing issues before opening a new one.

Report security problems through [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md).

Sparkable can offer contracted support as part of a separate Enterprise agreement. That service does not change the Community Edition license or capabilities.
